dataset: CardAdvisor — India Credit Card Point Valuations
description: What one reward point is realistically worth, in paisa, on every point-earning Indian credit card and reward programme — one value each, on the default redemption route. Pair it with the reward rates in the card-facts dataset: a rate read without its point value overstates returns several-fold. The route-by-route breakdown is published on cardadvisor.in/valuations. Independent, no paid placements. Free to cite with attribution.
citation: CardAdvisor — India Credit Card Point Valuations Dataset, live snapshot as of 2026-10-01. For a citable, immutable version see https://cardadvisor.in/data/versions.

fieldDictionary.cardKey: Stable slug; the card detail page is /cards/{cardKey}.
fieldDictionary.programName: The reward currency this card earns.
fieldDictionary.typicalPaisaPerPoint: Realistic per-point value on the default redemption route, in paisa (100 paisa = ₹1). The route-by-route breakdown is editorial and is published on the site, not in the open dataset.
